title: Protecting 10BASE-T1S Ethernet with MACsec
summary: 10BASE-T1S is a 10 Mb/s single-pair Ethernet technology that enables multiple devices, including sensors, actuators, and lighting controls, to communicate with a host MCU over a shared unshielded twisted-pair bus. The T1S physical wires are often located in remote locations, like peripheral zones, and are easily accessible for potential physical intervention, where the attacker may not only read the data, but also inject its own. Therefore, protecting T1S traffic is vitally important, and MACsec has been chosen as the industry-wide network security protocol.
